source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Ιουλίου — «Όσιοι Τέσσερις συνασκητές»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates nobody — it names none of the four and gives no place — so by the standing ruling it is one entry and one folder, not four. The number is itself unsettled on the page: «Οι Όσιοι Τέσσερις (κατ' άλλους τεσσαράκοντα) συνασκητές απεβίωσαν ειρηνικά», four in its own heading and forty on the authority of others; the display name keeps the listing's four and the disagreement is in the life. They reposed in peace and are not martyrs. The synaxarion distich calls them men and monastics, «Aνδρών μοναστών τετράριθμος ακρότης», which is where `sex` comes from. No year, no century, so there is no `dates` object. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints no hymn. The corpus's other four-companies — of Perge, of Tyre, with Theopemptus — are martyrs on other days and none of them is this company.
